description: Integrate effect-web-midi library to replace raw Web MIDI API with Effect-based streams and typed errors

userStories.title: Add effect-web-midi dependency
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the effect-web-midi library installed to use its Effect-based MIDI abstractions.
acceptanceCriteria: Run 'bun add effect-web-midi' in packages/client
Verify package.json includes effect-web-midi dependency
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Installed effect-web-midi@0.1.16 via bun add. Dependency added to packages/client/package.json. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Create StorageService for localStorage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an Effect-based wrapper for localStorage to safely persist MIDI device selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/client/src/services/storage.ts
Export StorageService Context.Tag with get/set/remove methods
Export StorageServiceLive layer using localStorage
Each method returns Effect.Effect (get returns string | null)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created StorageService with Context.GenericTag, get/set/remove methods returning Effect.Effect, and StorageServiceLive layer. Added 8 passing tests. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Refactor useMidi device listing to use effect-web-midi
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see available MIDI devices using the effect-web-midi library for typed access.
acceptanceCriteria: Import EMIDIAccess, EMIDIPort from effect-web-midi
Replace navigator.requestMIDIAccess() with EMIDIAccess.request()
Replace manual device enumeration with EMIDIPort.FullRecord
Filter to input devices only
Provide EMIDIAccess.layerDefault to run the effect
Preserve existing MidiDevice interface shape (id, name, manufacturer)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Refactored useMidi to use effect-web-midi for device listing. Uses EMIDIAccess.request() for typed MIDI access and EMIDIAccess.getInputsRecord() for typed device enumeration (input devices only). Uses EffectRecord.toEntries() for type-safe iteration. MidiDevice interface preserved. Updated mock classes for effect-web-midi instanceof checks. Typecheck passes. Note: Raw navigator.requestMIDIAccess() still used for state change handler (will be removed in US-005).

userStories.title: Refactor useMidi message subscription to use effect-web-midi
userStories.description: As a user, I want MIDI note events streamed from my device using effect-web-midi's typed message parsing.
acceptanceCriteria: Import EMIDIInput and Parsing from effect-web-midi
Replace manual onmidimessage handler with EMIDIInput.makeMessagesStreamById(inputId)
Pipe through Parsing.withParsedDataField for typed messages
Use Stream.filter with Predicate.or(Parsing.isNotePress, Parsing.isNoteRelease) to filter note events
Extract pitch/velocity from parsed message data field
Run stream with Effect.runFork, cleanup with Fiber.interrupt on unmount
Provide EMIDIAccess layer (layerDefault or layerSoftwareSynthSupported) to run the stream
Preserve existing MidiNoteEvent interface (pitch, velocity, timestamp, on)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Refactored useMidi message subscription to use effect-web-midi streams. Uses EMIDIAccess.makeMessagesStreamByInputId() for typed message stream. Pipes through Parsing.withParsedDataField for automatic message parsing. Filters with Predicate.or(Parsing.isNotePress, Parsing.isNoteRelease). Extracts pitch/velocity from parsed midiMessage payload. Runs stream with Effect.runFork, cleanup with Fiber.interrupt on unmount. Provides EMIDIAccess.layer(). Removed manual MIDI status byte parsing. MidiNoteEvent interface preserved. Typecheck passes. Note: Raw navigator.requestMIDIAccess() still used for state change handler (will be removed in US-005).

userStories.title: Add device hot-plug support using effect-web-midi streams
userStories.description: As a user, I want the device list to update automatically when I connect or disconnect MIDI devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Use EMIDIAccess.makeAllPortsStateChangesStreamInContext() to watch connection events
Handle events with shape { port, newState } where newState.ofDevice indicates connection status
Refresh device list when device connects or disconnects (check newState.ofDevice === 'disconnected')
Remove raw navigator.requestMIDIAccess() usage for onstatechange handler
Run state change stream alongside message stream
Properly cleanup both streams on unmount using Fiber.interrupt
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added hot-plug support using EMIDIAccess.makeAllPortsStateChangesStream(midiAccess). Removed rawMidiAccessRef and all raw navigator.requestMIDIAccess() usage. State change stream runs alongside message stream via stateChangeFiberRef. Both streams properly cleaned up on unmount with Fiber.interrupt. Device list refreshes on any port state change event. Typecheck passes.
